PDF VR Volume Rendering - University of Washington
Volume rendering is a pivotal technology in the realm of medical imaging. With VR being a brand new technology, there is room for medical imaging technology to be developed for virtual reality. Our goal is to create an experience in which radiologists and other healthcare professionals can view an accurate representation of MRI scans with intuitive controls.
